title: Vote Earth | Earth Day
metaDescription: Voting is one of the best ways to make a difference for the environment. Vote Earth to tell elected leaders to take action for the planet!
h2s: This page is a partnership between HeadCount and EARTHDAY.ORG. Information collected will be shared with both organizations.
We face an environmental crisis that requires an urgent and transformative response.

By educating yourself about the issues, pledging to vote, registering to vote, voting early and recruiting friends and family, you can build a more sustainable, healthier and just world.



It has never been more important to demand an end to business as usual. Exercise your civic duty.



Vote Earth.
